info.name: Psych Support API
info.description: Laravel backend. Run in order: Register/Login first, tokens are saved to collection variables.

request.description: Patient fields: dob (must be older than 16 years), gender (male|female), marital_status (single|married). Token is saved in {{token}}.

Doctor fields: specialization, dob, phone, photo, id_card_img, certificate_img are required; clinic_url and bio (max 300 characters) are optional. Status starts as pending, no token until an admin approves.
403 while status is pending or rejected.
Use the ADMIN_EMAIL / ADMIN_PASSWORD from your .env.
Also logs out every other device. The token used for this request stays valid.
Screen 1. With MAIL_MAILER=log the code is in storage/logs/laravel.log.
Screen 2. Wrong email or code: 422 with 'الإيميل أو الكود غير صحيح.'. Right code: 200 {valid: true} (the code is not used up).
Screen 3. Different passwords: 422 on password ('لازم يكونوا متطابقين'). Success: the app opens the login screen.

item.name: Rejected doctor: register my data again

formdata.description: the email the doctor registered with

request.description: For a doctor whose registration was REJECTED (Login (doctor) returns 403 with status=rejected and can_resubmit=true). The profile goes back to pending for a new review.

Patient or doctor. PERMANENT: deletes the account, the profile, chat messages and voice recordings, mood logs, completed challenges, posts, and for doctors the ID card, certificate and photo. Needs the current password. Use a throw-away account to try it.
Saves the first doctor's id into {{doctor_id}}.

exec: const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d && d.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set('doctor_id', d[0].id); }

request.description: Updates use POST so file uploads work. Send only the fields you want to change.
Same as the POST version. The doctor is logged out.
PERMANENT. Deletes the doctor and all his data.
PERMANENT.

Sends a recorded voice message. The reply contains chat.message (what was said), chat.emotion (happy|sad|angry|anxious|neutral), chat.emotion_score (0 to 1). Without CHATBOT_URL the backend answers with fixed stub values.
Only the patient who sent the recording can play it (404 for anyone else).
mood_score is 1 to 5. When it is 1 or 2 the answer has `challenge`: a random positive challenge for the pop-up.
Saves the first challenge's id into {{challenge_id}}. type: breathing | walking | reading.

exec: const c = pm.response.json().challenges; if (c && c.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set('challenge_id', c[0].id); }

request.description: Patient can edit first_name, last_name, dob (must be older than 16) and marital_status. Email and gender cannot be changed (ignored if sent). Send only what changed.
Active doctors only. Add ?specialization=psych to search.
Use the patient token, or log in as a doctor (Login (doctor) saves {{doctor_token}}) and put it in {{token}} to post as a doctor.
Patient posts are anonymous (author = null). Add ?type=doctor or ?type=patient to filter.
Only the author can edit a post (403 for anyone else).
Only the author can delete a post (403 for anyone else).

formdata.description: Changing it sends the account back to pending: you are logged out until an admin approves again
optional new profile picture; replaces the old one

request.description: Uses {{doctor_token}}. Doctor can edit first_name, last_name, phone, clinic_url, bio (max 300), photo and specialization. Changing the specialization puts the account back to pending and logs the doctor out until an admin approves again (requires_approval: true); any other change stays active. Email, date of birth, ID card, certificate and status cannot be changed.
